documents.name: Author guidelines
documents.title: Author guidelines v1.0
documents.body:
Who writes here
Contribution is by invitation. Your invitation named a section and a format; write to those.

Originality
The article must be yours and unpublished elsewhere. Reusing your own earlier work is fine if you say so.

Evidence
Every claim that a reader might reasonably doubt needs a source. Reference primary literature, not press releases.

Figures
Supply the figure, a caption, a credit and a licence. If you cannot state the licence, we cannot publish the image.

Declarations
Declare funding, commercial interests, and any use of AI tools beyond spelling and grammar.

Editing
We edit for clarity and house style, and send substantive changes back to you before publication.

After publication
Published articles are not edited in place. Corrections create a new version, and the record shows what changed.
